aions_core/server/generator_cbms.py.why: It turns retrieved chunks and ranking scores into a sourced answer, which is the search-and-rank side rather than the tone polishing of sounding-human.

aions_core/server/hangul_addressing.py.why: It only turns text into a compact Hangul address code, so it is the encoding scheme itself and not the storage folder that later holds such codes.

aions_core/server/korean_keys.py.why: It chops words into syllable-like fragments and hashes them into short match keys, which is the shorthand scheme, not the ranked retrieval that consumes it.

control_plane/skills/__init__.py.why: A bare package marker for the skill engine package, so it belongs with the action library rather than with permissions on those actions.

control_plane/skills/stats.py.why: These are the running tallies of how often each skill worked and how fast, used to pick a skill, not a live-health measurement of the machine.

mcpServers/VS_CODE_MCP_CODEX/src/patched.why: It is the Windows message-transport fix for the tool server's pipe, pure connection plumbing rather than any of the local abilities offered over it.

mcpServers/VS_CODE_MCP_CODEX/src/server..why: It is the catalogue service that offers every local ability to an outside assistant, not one of those abilities such as screen or file control.

server/store_selector.py.why: It is the switch between a remote and an embedded vector database, which the meaning-database area explicitly owns, not general environment setup.

aions_core/aions_hybrid_retrieval.py.why: It mixes keyword, vector and rerank passes to order results for a question, which is the act of searching rather than the vector store it queries.

aions_core/aions_reformed_integration.py.why: It is the layered lookup that tries simple seed answers before digging into memory, a retrieval decision rather than a store of chunks.

aions_core/ingest_cbms_data.py.why: It is a loading job that pushes batches of text plus embeddings into the vector table, not intake of outside web or chat content.

aions_core/server/cbms_memory.py.why: It writes one knowledge piece per JSON file and keeps the manifest with access counts, which is the plain files on disk, not the similarity database.

aions_core/server/cbms_symbolic_index.py.why: It is the code-to-chunk index where both question and material are written in the same symbolic codes, not embedding-based meaning search.

aions_core/server/web_rag_cbms.py.why: It reaches out to the web only when a question could not be answered locally and files the lines with their source URLs, which is intake of outside text.

aions_core/tools/check_status.py.why: It reads the recorded error list off a running service's status endpoint, a live-health check rather than a survey of files on disk.

control_plane/blends/search_blends.py.why: It searches the write-ups of past mistakes and the lessons drawn from them, which is long-term self-improvement, not general question answering.

control_plane/skills/schema.py.why: It defines the shape of a skill or recipe object and checks required fields; the risk field is only declared here, enforcement lives in the permissions area.

mcpServers/VS_CODE_MCP_CODEX/src/__main_.why: It is the start-up entry point choosing pipe or network transport and verifying the virtual environment, the connection layer's launcher not the assistant's own front door.

scripts/aions_node_heartbeat.py.why: It is the worker machine's regular check-in to the command centre so the fleet roll stays current, not the self-repair loop that watches services.

scripts/full_system_scan.py.why: It walks every drive to list files, dependencies and project roots into reports, a survey of disk contents rather than bookkeeping of knowledge folders.

scripts/set_aions_cache_env.sh.why: It points all download and temporary folders at one chosen drive, which is groundwork configuration rather than anything about running service health.

scripts/smoke_http_mcp.py.why: It proves the tool server's protocol handshake and tool listing work over the network, a connection-layer test rather than a demonstration of doing real jobs.

server/context_schema.py.why: It fixes the shape of the labels and expiry days attached to entries in the similarity store, not the conversational recall that reads those turns back.
